info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Weather Alerts Regions-v5-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Regions API provides access to geographical regions identified for weather alerts. Utilizing this endpoint, developers can retrieve a list of regions where weather alerts are in effect, facilitating proactive responses to weather-related events. This API serves meteorologists, emergency response teams, and applications focused on weather monitoring and public safety. By integrating this information, users can enhance situational awareness and ensure timely communication of alerts to affected communities.

get.description: Fetches the list of alerts specific to a certain geographical region. This endpoint allows users to monitor region-specific incidents and respond accordingly.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the parameters for retrieving alert information based on region. It should contain the necessary data required to process the request effectively.
